sloka: बिल्वा मार्दङ्गिका आसन् शम्याग्राहा विभीतका: ।अश्वत्थानर्त्तकाश्चासन् भरद्वाजस्य शासनात् ॥ २.९१.४८॥
transliteration: bilvā mārdaṅgikā āsan śamyāgrāhā vibhītakā: ।aśvatthānarttakāścāsan bharadvājasya śāsanāt ॥ 2.91.48॥

translations.english: The garlands of the gods available in Chitraratha's (Kubera's) garden could not match those obtained under the orders of Bharadwaja.
